snippet.title: Aux Battles are now available as a Discord activity!
snippet.description:
A new update has dropped to Aux Battles. Our game is now available as a Discord Activity! 
Just hop in a call with your friends select Aux Battles and you will automatically join a room, no code needed! 

#auxbattle #discordgaming #partygames #musicgame
